strike.description: A basic melee attack on an adjacent foe.

cleave.description: A heavy swing that also clips foes beside the target.

arc_shot.description: A lobbed arrow that cannot hit adjacent foes.

ember.description: A burst of flame at range.

mend.description: Restore the health of an ally, or your own.

riposte.description: A short answer, taken out of the same breath.

sunder.description: A blow aimed at the join rather than the man.

whirl.description: A turn on the spot with the edge out. Everything close pays.

lunge.description: Reaching further than a sword ought to.

scorch.description: A close, mean flame. Nothing showy about it.

pyre.description: Fire laid down over ground rather than aimed at anybody.

firebrand.description: A handful of heat thrown without much thought.

spark.description: A quick white line between you and them.

thunderhead.description: Weather brought down on a place, not a person.

chain_bolt.description: It finds the far end of the field and stops there.

snipe.description: One arrow, taken slowly, from a long way off.

hamstring.description: Low and behind the knee. Not honourable, but effective.

volley.description: Everything in the quiver, at everything in the way.

crush.description: Weight brought down from over the shoulder.

shield_bash.description: The flat of it, hard, before they are ready.

earthshake.description: A blow into the ground. What is standing on it goes over.

warding_touch.description: A hand on the shoulder, and whatever was wrong is less so.

stand_fast.description: Said quickly, to somebody who was about to go down.

hearthlight.description: Warmth put over a knot of people at once.

second_wind.description: Finding a bit more of yourself than you thought was left.

grief.description: Handed over whole, to somebody who has not earned it.

lament.description: A sound that gets into more than one of them.

keening.description: Thin, carrying, and it reaches further than it should.

gust.description: Air with an edge on it, put through a crowd.

dart.description: Barely a movement. They are bleeding before they notice.

long_reach.description: The wind takes it the last few yards for you.
